outputs.explanation: Panel A is a domain-map schematic combined with western blot images; it contains no plotted averages requiring individual data points.

Panel B shows bar charts of single densitometry quantification values per antibody (percent depletion / log2 elution abundance) with no indication these are averages across replicates (no error bars or 'mean' stated), so individual points are not applicable.
Panel C is a heatmap, which is exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel D consists of violin plots, which already display the full data distribution and are exempt from this check.
Panel E bar charts show mean ± SD (n=4) with individual data points (circles) overlaid on each bar.
Panel F contains a sequence alignment and a molecular structure model, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel G is a scatterplot; individual points are inherently the data shown, so overlay is not applicable.
Panel H is a scatterplot of individual IP-MS experiments; points are already individual data, exempt from this check.
Panel I is a PCA scatterplot; individual points are the data itself, exempt from this check.
Panel J consists of PCA scatterplots; individual points are the data itself, exempt from this check.
